title: Holy God, We Praise Thy Name
description: Holy God, We Praise Thy Name in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Ignaz Franz, first published in 1774. The English translation is by Clarence Alphonsus Walworth (1858). The tune, TE DEUM, is from Katholisches Gesangbuch, Maria Theresa, 1774. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Ho-ly God,_ we praise_ Thy Name; Lord of all,_ we bow_ be-fore Thee! All on earth_ Thy scep_-ter claim, All in Hea-ven a-bove_ a-dore Thee; In-fin_-ite_ Thy vast do_-main, Ev-er-last_-ing is_ Thy reign.

lines: Holy God, we praise Thy Name;
Lord of all, we bow before Thee!
All on earth Thy scepter claim,
All in Heaven above adore Thee;
Fill the heavens with sweet accord:
Join the sacred Name to hallow;
And the white robed martyrs follow;
And from morn to set of sun,
Through the Church the song goes on.
Holy Spirit, Three we name Thee;
